test_title: PYST 01: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

 # : VEC :: BNW : %
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] The logic followed here is: Option 1) # = DQU, % = XHA [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4d05f18de5d02f581864126c7c3ed4c603ba968014f53e240808b78f31c704a.png] Does not follow same logic. Option 2) # = FTS, % = XHA
